title: docs.ramp.com/llms-guides/ramp-mcp.txt
snippet:
Ramp MCP allows you to securely connect Ramp with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude, so you can query Ramp data and take actions with natural language. Admins can analyze data to identify spend trends and forecasting insights, while employees can check balances, request reimbursements, or get policy answers directly from their daily tools.

Getting started
A Ramp production or sandbox account
Access to your chosen AI platform (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)
Using demo data
Replace https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp with https://demo-mcp.ramp.com/mcp in any config below to use sample data instead of live Ramp data.
Add the Ramp MCP server to your Claude Code session:
Run /mcp in your session to verify the connection.
Cursor desktop app required
The Cursor desktop app must be installed for this one-click link to work.
Or add manually to ~/.cursor/mcp.json:
Add the following to your Claude Desktop config file:
macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
Add the following to your VS Code MCP settings:
For any MCP-compatible client, use the server URL to configure a connection:
Production: https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp
Demo: https://demo-mcp.ramp.com/mcp
Check your tool's MCP documentation for configuration format.
If you manage more than one Ramp business, create one MCP connection per business. Ramp treats any unused path in the form https://mcp.ramp.com/<business-identifier>/mcp as an alias for the production Ramp MCP server, so each client connection can keep its own OAuth session.
Use a memorable identifier for each business. For example:
Acme Corporate Ramp MCP: https://mcp.ramp.com/acme-corporate/mcp
Acme Europe Ramp MCP: https://mcp.ramp.com/acme-europe/mcp
Then authenticate each connection while signed in to the matching Ramp business. The identifier in the URL is only a client-side label and routing alias; Ramp permissions still come from the authenticated user and selected business.

<ComparisonCell choice="api">
In deterministic code

Use the [Ramp app](https://app.ramp.com) when a person needs to review context,
handle an exception, or complete work directly. The
[Agent Tools reference](/docs/reference/agent-tools) lists every tool available
in the CLI and MCP.
## CLI
Use the CLI when the agent has terminal access, needs structured output, or
should follow a repeatable skill. The CLI works well in Claude Code, Codex,
Cursor, scripts, and CI.
<CliInstallButton />
## Connect via MCP
Choose the client you already use. Each link opens the fastest available way to
add Ramp.

## Custom MCP clients
Point the client at `https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp`. For the Ramp sandbox
(demo.ramp.com, the same environment as the CLI's `--env sandbox`), use
`https://demo-mcp.ramp.com/mcp`. Clients that read MCP JSON usually expect:
```json
{
"mcpServers": {
"ramp": {
"url": "https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp"
}
}
}
```
Custom clients and gateways need their exact redirect URI allowlisted before
authorization can complete:
- Use `https://`, or `http://` only with `localhost` or `127.0.0.1`. Ramp also
accepts the `claude://`, `cursor://`, `grokbot://`, and `perplexity-app://`
schemes; other custom schemes are not supported.
- Submit the exact host. Wildcard subdomains are not supported.
- [Request redirect URI access](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/mcp-redirect-whitelist-request)
for the client or gateway.

title: Ramp Data MCP
snippet:
**Ramp Data MCP**
The Ramp Data MCP server exposes Ramp's datasets — [Ramp Rate](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ramp-rate) software benchmarks and [AI Index](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ai-index) business AI adoption metrics — to MCP-compatible clients.
**Server URL:** `https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/mcp`
One MCP connection queries both datasets — the tools live on the same server. For the per-dataset tool list, see [AI Index → Available AI Index tools](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ai-index#available-ai-index-tools) and [Ramp Rate → Available Ramp Rate tools](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ramp-rate#available-ramp-rate-tools).
Ramp Data requires provisioned access. [Apply to the Ramp Data Partner Program](https://ramp.com/data-partnerships) to request credentials.
Set `RAMP_DATA_API_KEY` in your environment before using the Claude Code or Cursor examples. For Claude Desktop, replace `<YOUR_RAMP_DATA_API_KEY>` in the config.

### Claude Code
Add the Ramp Data MCP server to your Claude Code session:
Add Ramp Data MCP to Claude Code
Shell
```
claude mcp add --transport http ramp-data https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/mcp \  --header "Authorization: Bearer $RAMP_DATA_API_KEY"
```
Run `/mcp` in your session to verify the connection.
### Cursor
Add the server to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`:
Cursor MCP Configuration
JSON
```
{  "mcpServers": {    "ramp-data": {      "url": "https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/mcp",      "headers": {        "Authorization": "Bearer ${env:RAMP_DATA_API_KEY}"      }    }  }}
```

Claude Desktop Configuration
JSON
```
{  "mcpServers": {    "ramp-data": {      "command": "npx",      "args": [        "mcp-remote",        "https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/mcp",        "--header",        "Authorization:${AUTH_HEADER}"      ],      "env": {        "AUTH_HEADER": "Bearer <YOUR_RAMP_DATA_API_KEY>"      }    }  }}
```
### Other MCP clients
For any MCP-compatible client, use the server URL `https://mcp.ramp.com/ramp-data/mcp` and send your provisioned API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_RAMP_DATA_API_KEY>` header.

- **Ramp Rate tools** — list categories, fetch category summaries, rank vendors within a category, resolve a vendor name to a slug, get a vendor's full profile, compare 2–10 vendors. Full list: [Ramp Rate → Available Ramp Rate tools](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ramp-rate#available-ramp-rate-tools).

- [Ramp MCP](https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/ramp-mcp) — Ramp's account-scoped MCP serve
